info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of International Business

description.describe_ch: 本課程結合數據分析與永續發展議題，旨在培養學生利用實際數據進行深入分析的能力。本課程將引導學生撰寫程式，分析與永續發展相關的真實世界數據，從而深入了解環境、社會責任、健康、教育及經濟發展等方面的挑戰。透過實作練習，學生將能夠掌握數據分析在永續發展中的應用，並對感興趣的主題進行深入探討。
description.describe_eh: In “Sustainable Development and Data Analysis”, a sophisticated synthesis of data analysis techniques and sustainability topics is undertaken. The course aims to develop students’ ability to analyze real-world data, with a focus on sustainability-related issues. It encompasses an exploration of environmental, social, health, education and economic aspects of sustainability. Students will engage in programming and data analysis, applying these skills to investigate issues of interest within the realm of sustainability. This approach not only enhances understanding of the challenges in sustainable development but also demonstrates the practical application of data analysis in addressing these issues.

targets.describe_ch: 學生具備跨領域永續發展的深入了解以及分析相關議題的能力
targets.describe_en: Students gain interdisciplinary understanding of sustainable development and the ability to analyze related issues effectively.

targets.describe_ch: 學生掌握永續發展知識，並具備全球視野，以應對國際重要趨勢
targets.describe_en: Students acquire knowledge in sustainable development and develop a global perspective to address this vital international trend.
